contradictions.description: F2 states the UPS carried the load for 15 minutes before generators took over, while F14 states the UPS carried the load for only 9 minutes before Generator B was started.
F3 claims normal service was restored at 06:34, whereas F18 claims the utility feed was restored and service confirmed normal at 08:05.
F6 says failover to Generator B was approved by Priya Raman, Operations Lead, while F15 says failover was approved by Daniel Okafor, Operations Lead.
F21 claims Generator B’s tank held roughly 11 hours of runtime at the start of the incident, whereas F27 claims the tank was at 20 percent, enough for about 3 hours.
F7 states the utility fault was triggered by a storm, while F31 reports clear skies, no precipitation, and no wind above 12 km/h on the night of 13 to 14 March.
F24 reports 41 premium tier customers were affected, whereas F35 reports 38 premium-tier customers were affected.
